# Apache PDFBox application 3.0.8

The retained `pdfbox-app-3.0.8.jar` is an unmodified Apache PDFBox release
artifact used only by the repository's test tooling. It was downloaded from:

https://archive.apache.org/dist/pdfbox/3.0.8/pdfbox-app-3.0.8.jar

Its SHA-512 digest is:

`768847238f683568507bf73570a2b6fedcbe58b25c7b4f97fba536ba110b290fe96ba065aed58629d41fb94857d76bc1978c2f31d294b553c69f287f71ee9600`

The artifact contains its complete applicable license and attribution material
at `META-INF/LICENSE` and `META-INF/NOTICE`. Those embedded files are part of
the retained, checksum-pinned artifact and cover PDFBox and its bundled
third-party components.

Apache PDFBox application
Copyright 2002-2026 The Apache Software Foundation

This product includes software developed at The Apache Software Foundation.
It is based on source code originally developed in the PDFBox and FontBox
projects, copyright 2002-2007, www.pdfbox.org.

The embedded notice also attributes the Adobe Glyph List, Zapf Dingbats Glyph
List, Unicode Bidi Mirroring data, and parts of TwelveMonkeys ImageIO. Consult
`META-INF/NOTICE` inside the JAR for the authoritative notice text.
